title: kate-ui: show the project tree and the document list panes
summary: cmd-shift-e toggles a sidebar with two sections. The upper section paints tree::visible_rows for the project; a click on a directory expands or collapses it and a click on a file opens it. The lower section paints doclist::document_rows; a click activates that document's view.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
// gpui::actions!(kate_ui, [...]) declares these unit structs.
pub struct ToggleSidebar;

/// Add `path` to the set, or remove it when it is there. Returns true when it is expanded after the call.
fn toggle_expanded(expanded: &mut std::collections::BTreeSet<std::path::PathBuf>, path: &std::path::Path) -> bool

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Store sidebar_open, the TreeNode built from the project file list, and the expanded set on WindowRoot. Render the sidebar at a fixed width of 240 px on the left when open. A directory row click calls toggle_expanded. A file row click sends FileRequest::OpenPath for base_dir joined with the row path. A document row click calls Workspace::activate on the first view of that document. Bind cmd-shift-e and add Toggle Sidebar to the View menu. The test toggle_expanded_flips_the_set asserts an empty set becomes expanded for src and returns true, and a second call removes it and returns false. The owner opens a file in a project and sees the tree. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::toggle_expanded_flips_the_set
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because toggle_expanded does not exist. After the change a path toggles in and out of the set.
